title: question_links clause 5 reads bc7b's writes_to from a measured fixture
intention: question_links' clause-5 tooth reads bc7b64626405's decompose writes_to from a measured fixture berthed as a scratch decompose, so it reads the same on every box, and still reds where a live berth disagrees with the fixture.
why: Measured 2026-11-13 on akienasus: test_question_links.py clause 5 read writes_to=0, because bc7b64626405's decompose berth stands only on the charting box; the tooth requires >= 10.
traces_to: Law 8 (a proof reads the same on every box) and Law 5 (berths are instance-space; the fixture records what they held).
how: The fixture is this ticket's measured entry carrying writes_to (13 paths, measured on akiendelllinux). The tooth reads it with read_ticket, writes a scratch <root>/0/packets/decompose-20260914T163354-d80b7071aa57.json claiming bc7b64626405 with those writes_to, and passes roots={'berths': <root>} to proof_binds_its_subject_at_call_time and berths_root to _writes_to. Where the live chain names a decompose for bc7b, its writes_to must equal the fixture, or the tooth reds naming bc7b64626405.

clauses.claim: test_question_links.py is green on akienasus, which holds no bc7b64626405 berth, with writes_to read as 13
a live berth claiming bc7b64626405 whose writes_to differs from the fixture reds, naming the ticket

decisions.text: D1: clause 5 reads its writes_to from this ticket's measured fixture through a scratch decompose berth, and asserts a live berth agrees.

measured.how: measured by the orchestrator on akiendelllinux
